title: Razorpay and Zoho Books Integration
seoTitle: Razorpay Zoho Books Integration and Reconciliation
seoDescription: Record Razorpay payments, fees and settlements in Zoho Books automatically and match them to invoices. Native options, limits and custom approaches.
summary: A Razorpay–Zoho Books integration marks invoices paid when customers pay through Razorpay, records gateway fees and GST on fees, and matches settlements to bank deposits, so receivables stay accurate without manual matching.

dataPoints.label: What syncs
dataPoints.value: Payments against invoices, gateway fees, refunds, settlements

dataPoints.label: Native option
dataPoints.value: Zoho Books supports Razorpay as a payment gateway for invoice payments

dataPoints.label: When custom is needed
dataPoints.value: Payments made outside Zoho invoices, such as website or app checkouts

dataPoints.label: Typical effort
dataPoints.value: Configuration for native use; 2–4 weeks for custom reconciliation

body:
## Native versus custom

If customers pay from Zoho invoice links, the built-in gateway connection covers most needs. If payments come from a website, app or subscription system, a custom sync matches them to invoices using reference numbers.

See [TallyPrime vs Zoho Books](/compare/tally-vs-zoho-books) and the [Tally and Razorpay integration](/integrations/tally-razorpay).

Tool features and APIs change; confirm current capabilities before scoping.

faqs.q: Are Razorpay fees recorded with GST?
faqs.a: They should be: fees and the GST charged on them go to separate ledgers for input credit.
Custom matching can apply partial payments and flag mismatches for review.
